source.title: NHAI unaudited quarterly financial results June2025 to June2026, with explicit restatements and original filing vintages
source.license_terms: Public authority financial filings; attribution, original statement scope and PDF page citation required. No separate open-data license inferred.

citations.note: All selected filings explicitly unaudited and limited-review, not C&AG audited results. Publication dates unknown. Current canonical March2026 income/expenditure uses explicit June2026 restatement; per-document typed vintages archived. No income-from-operations metric: NHAI acts for Government. Debt-stock, classic balance sheet, gross toll receipts, CFI deposits and net adjusted ploughback cash flow have separate statement scopes. December2025 PDF clips deposit amount; omitted. March2026 notes call849402.21 second-quarter despite Dec2025 filing reporting it as third-quarter; ambiguous comparative not promoted. Claims for March2026 published in June filing remain dated March2026, not June. September working stock uses same-date YTD column (14509175.02 lakh current assets), consistent with its classic balance sheet; three-month cell14509175.00 is retained as a document diagnostic, not a duplicate observation.
